description: Fictional World-only corpus with explicit UTC effective instants for changed relationships, plus a disputed-report control. Version 2 tests timestamp-representable changes; date-only version 1 remains the product-limitation probe. Sources are closed fixtures. No oracle is included.

scenarios.title: A chief executive is replaced on a stated date

sources.title: Corvane Logistics names Lena Ortiz chief executive
sources.text: Corvane Logistics, a fictional freight company, said its board appointed Lena Ortiz as chief executive officer effective January 5, 2026 at 09:00 UTC. Ortiz began serving as chief executive at that instant.

sources.title: Corvane Logistics changes chief executive
sources.text: Corvane Logistics said Lena Ortiz stepped down as chief executive officer effective June 15, 2026 at 09:00 UTC. The board appointed Marcus Hale as chief executive officer effective June 15, 2026 at 09:00 UTC. From that instant Hale is the chief executive, and Ortiz no longer holds a role at Corvane Logistics.

scenarios.title: A headquarters moves on a stated date

sources.title: Brightwell Foods company profile
sources.text: Brightwell Foods, a fictional packaged-food maker, has been headquartered in Austin, Texas since its head office opened there on March 1, 2019 at 09:00 UTC.

sources.title: Brightwell Foods relocates its headquarters
sources.text: Brightwell Foods relocated its headquarters from Austin, Texas to Denver, Colorado, effective July 1, 2026 at 09:00 UTC. From that instant Denver is the company's headquarters and the Austin office is no longer its headquarters.

scenarios.title: A supply contract is terminated on a stated date

sources.title: Kestrel Semiconductor wins Halden Motors supply contract
sources.text: Kestrel Semiconductor, a fictional chipmaker, began supplying power modules to Halden Motors under a supply contract that took effect on January 15, 2026 at 09:00 UTC.

sources.title: Halden Motors ends Kestrel Semiconductor contract
sources.text: Halden Motors terminated its power-module supply contract with Kestrel Semiconductor effective September 30, 2026 at 17:00 UTC. From that instant Kestrel Semiconductor no longer supplies power modules to Halden Motors.

scenarios.title: A denied allegation does not end a contract

sources.title: Orion Ferry Works signs Pell Shipyards contract
sources.text: Orion Ferry Works, a fictional steel fabricator, supplies hull steel to Pell Shipyards under a contract that took effect on April 2, 2026 at 09:00 UTC.

sources.title: Short-seller report on Pell Shipyards suppliers
sources.text: A short-seller report published on August 10, 2026 at 09:00 UTC alleges that Pell Shipyards plans to stop buying hull steel from Orion Ferry Works. Pell Shipyards denied the report and said its contract with Orion Ferry Works remains in force.
